title: The King's Hit List, Part 7
description: The King's Hit List, Part 7 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Baern - Sir Fess of Maerz

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Use the Guild Teleporter on Level 6 of Shadow's Embrace, kill the Guild of Shadows Franchise Operator and the Guild of Shadows Guards in The Embercore Path, collect their Proofs of Pwnage, read the Book of the Shadows, and report back to Sir Ving N'Seacressy.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Baern - Sir Fess of Maerz

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: The King's Hit List, Part 8

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Use the Guild Teleporter on Level 6 of Shadow's Embrace, kill the Guild of Shadows Franchise Operator and the Guild of Shadows Guards in The Embercore Path, collect their Proofs of Pwnage, read the Book of the Shadows, and report back to Sir Ving N'Seacressy.

Offer:

You are the one Sir Ving N'Seacressy says *might* be investigating the *supposed* activities or *lack there of* in the Shadow's Embrace, eh? What is with Sir Ving anyways?! I bet you couldn't get a straight answer out of him if you asked him what his name is, or what's his favorite damage type. After every conversation with him I feel like I was given a true or false pop quiz and never got the answers.

There is a Guild of Shadows Franchise Operator actively seeking to open up a chain of Guild of Shadows throughout the Embercore Path. Needless to say this is bad for us. It is also telling that the Guild of Shadows is looking to branch out after keeping a very tight reign on their operations for so long. It makes me think that they are reacting to something that is happening internally. Maybe that is what has been causing some disruption in the Shadow's Embrace?

I bet if you take down the Guild of Shadows Franchise Operator and his Guards you might be able to learn more, especially if you can find the Book Stand of the Book of the Shadows. It will likely help you to learn more about what is happening in their guild. You can find them on Level 6 of the Embercore Path, and don't forget about the Guild of Shadows teleporter on Level 6 of the Shadow's Embrace. The teleport will take you to the Embercore Path as well as return you back when you are done. While you are doing that I'll work some of my contacts over and see what else I can learn. Report back to Sir Ving N'Seacressy when you are done.

Turn-in:

If we lived in an alternate world where you've got gum actually meant nice and in your nasal passage, stupid meant work, then in that alternate world I would walk up to you, probably backwards because that is how they walk in this world, and probably say something like Hey, Dungeon Runner, you've got gum in your nasal passage, stupid.

Objectives:

  • Guild Teleporter on Level 6 ×1
  • Kill the Guild of Shadows Guards
  • Kill the Guild of Shadows Franchise Operator
  • Collect the Proofs of Pwnage ×3
  • Learn about the Guild of Shadows ×1

Client level range: 45–100
